item.description:
Scriberman 1.1.0

What’s new

  • Rename speakers with saved-name suggestions, merge speakers, or assign a transcript block to another speaker.
  • See each speaker’s talk time and reset names from the new Speakers list.
  • Rename or merge saved speaker profiles and remove individual voiceprints in Settings.

Fixes

  • Saved Markdown transcripts now match the speaker names and transcript shown in the app.
